Rewritten for Facebook: package, both Meta signer digests, and the 577.0.0.50.72 arm64 target with its version code and floor as andrewliang25/morphe-patches declares it.

Rewritten from the source at that commit, not cherry-picked. Packages, extension descriptors, log tags, injected method names and the cache folder renamed; plain patch names with categories; the two feed guards merged into one shared hook; a settings switch in front of the story, reel, browser and download hooks; the list register of the story filter computed for static and wide parameters; the borrowed v0 in the reel collection hooks checked; the DASH join ends a track on an empty read and shifts both tracks by one lead-in; the reel handler answers null instead of Facebook's renamed kotlin.Unit; the debug println lines removed. Andrew Liang credits FroggoMorphePatches for some ideas and implementations.

Written for Hushfacebook: the shared feed hook and filter (the chokepoint and getters follow andrewliang25/morphe-patches, the PROMOTION rule follows FroggoMorphePatches), the extension context hook, the settings switches and status flags, and the launcher-shortcut settings screen built the way Hushfeed's settings are.
